system.description:
• Effect: Each dawn, choose a season. It lasts until the next dawn.
  • Spring: each creature healed by a spell you cast regains extra HP equal to your Wisdom modifier, once per casting.
  • Summer: once per round, one creature your spell damages takes extra damage equal to your Wisdom modifier.
  • Autumn: each creature that fails a save against your spell can't regain HP and can't take the Disengage action until the end of its next turn.
  • Winter: each creature your spell damages loses 10ft of speed until the end of its next turn.
